title: Message request
description: PERD 39.2 (REQ-API-001, REQ-INP-001, REQ-INP-003, REQ-AMB-005, REQ-UI-002): the body of a customer's message to the core, for POST /v1/conversations (the first message) and POST /v1/conversations/{conversation_ref}/messages (a follow-up: a new turn, or the answer to a clarification). PERD 39.2 lists {request_id, text, locale_hint?} for the first and {request_id, text?, option_id?, clarification_id?} for the second; this file is the union, so a route that takes the first message requires `text` itself. 'None of these' is an `option_id`: the core mints a `none_option_id` for each clarification and the UI submits it as `option_id` (ruling A275); the UI never invents a sentinel, and no boolean or other member stands for it. The body names no identity: the principal, the tenant and the role come from the authenticated session only (INV-12, AGENT-10, ruling A1), and the edge's body guard refuses such a member anyway. `request_id` is the client's lower-case UUID, the key of deduplication (common.v1 ClientRequestId, REQ-INP-003). `text` is the customer's own words, 1 to 2,000 characters as in canonical-input.v2 (the Gateway normalises it and masks it; no digit-run rule applies to inbound text). `locale_hint` has the shape of canonical-input.v2's. `option_id` has the shape of an option on the overlay card (overlay-card.v1: at most four digits in all, at most 32 characters). `clarification_id` names the server-issued clarification the message answers; an `option_id` needs it, so the answer is tied to that clarification (the core rejects a malformed, forged or replayed answer: it binds only to the current clarification, REQ-AMB-005). Three rules PERD 39.2 does not state are the safer reading and are reported for the Architect to confirm or loosen (a loosening is additive, a tightening is breaking): a message carries `text` or `option_id`; it does not carry both; free text may answer a clarification, so `clarification_id` may accompany `text`. Unknown members are refused (the PERD's 'ignored with a warning' for public APIs is [REC] and this file is closed, as every request contract is). New file; no earlier contract changes (AGENT-15).

text.description: The customer's message or free-text answer. Unicode, 1 to 2,000 characters (REQ-INP-001; the Gateway normalises NFC and trims).

locale_hint.description: Optional language tag of the customer's device or choice, as in canonical-input.v2.

option_id.description: The option the customer chose, as shown on the clarification card, or the core-minted none_option_id of that clarification for 'None of these' (A275). Never a value the UI made up.

clarification_id.description: The server-issued clarification this message answers. Required with option_id.
